text:
Sam (People Ops): Drafting a compact 'Week One' manager runbook for new hires. Keeping it concise for busy managers. Please quick-review and drop any must-haves. Link to canonical doc: https://redwood.ok/onboard-week1 :wave:

Sam (People Ops): TL;DR runbook (one-pager):
- Pre-day (48-24h): confirm laptop + peripherals, access requests filed, intro email to team + buddy, calendar blocks created.
- Day 1 morning: welcome + org orientation (30m), manager 1:1 (30m), team intro + buddy meet (30m).
- Day 1 afternoon: tooling & accounts (git, CI, slack channels), security brief (15m).
- Day 2: product context + architecture overview, join product sync.
- Day 3: dev workflow walkthrough (local dev, tests, CI), first small onboarding PR assigned.
- Day 4: cross-team intros (infra/devex/security as relevant), 30/60/90 draft with manager.
- Day 5: ship small PR or pair on a deploy shadow, feedback session + next steps.

Mia (Eng Manager): Love the brevity. Two additions: 1) include a short checklist for "first commit" eligibility (reviewers, CI flake checklist). 2) Add expectation-setting bullets for manager 1:1 on Day1 (role purpose, success metrics, communication norms).

Sam (People Ops): Added both. Will add a tiny "first commit" rubric: unit tests present, lint green, 1 reviewer from the squad, green CI or known flaky test note.

Alex (DevEx): Also include a link to the quick local dev guide and a starter issues list. Recommend a "starter PR" label so reviewers can triage quickly. We can auto-apply for new-hire accounts.

Raj (IT): Reminder for managers: create IT provisioning ticket as soon as offer is accepted. Form: https://redwood.ok/it-newhire. If ticket submitted before 10:00 PST on start day, we usually have hardware + VPN ready same day. For HSM/KMS access include manager approval in the ticket body.

Sam (People Ops): Buddy guidance: pick a peer not the manager, buddy commits to 4 weeks of pairing (15 min stand daily week1, then 2x/week), hosts first-week 'how we ship' demo. Buddy assigned on pre-day.

Mia (Eng Manager): For 30/60/90, suggest providing managers with a fillable template that has team-level outcomes prefilled (OKRs, major milestones) and space for role-specific goals. Use measurable checkpoints (PRs, code ownership, incident participation).

Sam (People Ops): We'll include an editable Google doc template and an example filled for backend/frontend roles. Also adding a one-slide "who to ask" cheat sheet (payroll, benefits, oncall, infra, security).

Jordan (new-hire): Quick Q: for the Day3 onboarding PR, how big should it be?

Mia (Eng Manager): Hi Jordan! Aim for a tiny, meaningful change: fix a small bug, add a test, or tweak docs. Not more than 2-3 files and one failing case fixed. We'll pair if you want.

Alex (DevEx): Jordan 12: starter issues for your first 2 weeks: https://redwood.ok/starter-issues. We'll reserve one for you and mark it "starter-pr" so reviewers know it's onboarding.

OnboardBot: Calendar invites created: Week1 onboarding 10:00-12:00 daily local time. Manager, buddy, and new hire added.

Sam (People Ops): Final ask: managers 12 please confirm buddy and submit IT ticket at least 48h before start. I'll publish the one-pager and the editable 30/60/90 by EOD. Thanks all for the quick feedback. :sparkles:
